title: light quenching brazilian cherry tomatoes poke
description: a yeasty, molten brazilian dish featuring cherry tomatoes, poached to perfection and infused with ayurvedic spices. this recipe is a delightful twist on traditional poke bowls.
instructions: in a small saucepan, combine coconut oil, yeast, and 1/4 cup of coconut water. heat over low heat, whisking constantly, until yeast dissolves.
add the remaining coconut water, yuzu juice, apple cider vinegar, honey, dried oregano, dried basil, and black pepper to the saucepan. whisk until well combined.
bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat. cook for 5 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
add the cherry tomatoes to the saucepan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until they start to release their juices.
remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
transfer the cherry tomato mixture to a serving bowl and drizzle with the poaching liquid. serve immediately.
